pr_title: fix: import with query with exports/browser field
pr_body:
### Description

The previous PR (#7073) did fix for cases like `.png?url` which becomes url regardless of `?url`, but did not work with other cases.

This PR fix for those. For example, `.json?url`, `.wasm?url`. (I overlooked `.json?url` was broken...)

fix #6725 
fix #7281 

### Additional context

refs #7097

Thanks @MadLittleMods for mentioning.

I digged down this and found that this was happening because `tryNodeResolve` was stripping `?used`. ([element-plus has exports field](https://github.com/element-plus/element-plus/blob/93ee3929326320878f4cfee09478a5547b714ce3/packages/element-plus/package.json#L19-L31))

This is the same reason for #6725 and it will be fixed with #7098.
It worked when I tried with #7098 actually.

review_comments:
It's unclear to me how only this test change covers the `*.html?url` and non-ESM `*.js?url` cases which failed in [two](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/pull/7097#discussion_r815299116) [different](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/pull/7097#discussion_r815295452) ways before this PR.

It seems like we should add test cases for each of those scenarios, example tests in https://github.com/vitejs/vite/pull/7097

Thoses cases failed because `import 'something?url'` was not returning url. They were treated as if `?url` does not exist.
So I changed this test case to check if the exported value is url.
Your explanation makes sense. I'd be favor of a comment to explain what we're expecting here as it was a little obtuse for me to follow ⏩
